Reading one word at a time sounds strange, but it works. The eye stays in one place; the words come to it. Some words are short, some are extraordinarily long, and a few are hyphenated, like well-known or state-of-the-art. Does that matter? It does! A longer word needs more time: that is what pacing is for. In a typical session you start slowly, speed up, and settle. If you lose your place, skip back a little. That is all there is to it -- really.
